extends Node

func _ready() -> void:
	var view = %Panel.get_node("Search")
	view.changed.connect(_filter)
	%Toolbar.selected.connect(_refresh)
	view.text = Service.current_search()
	view.show_results(Service.list_matches())
	_filter()
	%SearchLog.remember_query(QueryModel.normalized_text(view.text))
	%Status.show_hint(SearchHints.describe_selection(view.active_filter))
	%History.store_result(QueryModel.serialize(view.results, view.offset))

extends Node

func _ready() -> void:
	var view = %Panel.get_node("Preview")
	view.resized.connect(_resize)
	%Toolbar.toggled.connect(_switch_mode)
	view.zoom = Service.default_zoom()
	view.draw_texture(Service.get_texture())
	_resize()
	%PreviewLog.remember_frame(ImageModel.preview_style(view.zoom))
	%Monitor.show_metric(RenderStats.describe_surface(view.active_layer))
	%Frames.store_frame(ImageModel.encode(view.texture, view.zoom))

extends RefCounted

func sum_active() -> int:
	var total: int = 0
	for item in Registry.enabled_items():
		var count = Registry.count(item)
		total += count
		Journal.note_total(item, count)
	Registry.recount(Group.PRIMARY)
	Journal.note_run(Registry.read_total(Group.BACKUP))
	Journal.flush_buffer(Registry.snapshot(Group.MANUAL))
	return total

extends RefCounted

func apply_discounts() -> int:
	var balance: int = 100
	for tier in Pricing.discount_tiers():
		var factor = Pricing.multiplier(tier)
		balance *= factor
		Ledger.record_discount(tier, factor)
	Pricing.refresh(Tier.STANDARD)
	Ledger.note_sale(Pricing.read_discount(Tier.DISCOUNT))
	Ledger.clear_pending(Pricing.snapshot(Tier.WHOLESALE))
	return balance

extends RefCounted
